name: AlimentBench
intro: “AlimentBench”仅在Hunyuan-TurboS方法段出现一次，结合该段前文的AlignBench v1.1与结果表中的AlignmentBench，可判定为同一评测的拼写变体。本条目映射到AlignBench论文流程，而不把它当作独立benchmark。

task_type: 开放式问答, 对齐评测
eval_feature: 规则校准多维LLM裁判, 思维链解释, 人工参考答案
build_method_en: Real-scenario queries, human-in-the-loop curation, human references and web evidence
eval_feature_en: Rule-calibrated multidimensional LLM judge, chain-of-thought explanations, human references
intro_en: “AlimentBench” appears once in the Hunyuan-TurboS methodology text. The same passage names AlignBench v1.1 and the results table uses AlignmentBench, so this entry is treated as a spelling variant of the same evaluation and mapped to the AlignBench paper rather than presented as an independent benchmark.

drawio_review_note: Mapped to arXiv:2311.18743 rather than treated as a standalone benchmark. “AlimentBench” appears once in the Hunyuan-TurboS methodology immediately after the report names AlignBench v1.1; the results table labels the same 10-point evaluation “AlignmentBench.” The diagram therefore follows the AlignBench paper and records the source spelling as an alias boundary.
